## Disclosure checklist (docs/DISCLOSURE_POLICY.md)

- [ ] No credentials, account identifiers, budget ledgers or billing data
- [ ] No machine names, hostnames, IPs, local paths or usernames
- [ ] No links or IDs from private workspaces, no link-only shares
- [ ] No raw agent transcripts, prompts or memory; journal template used
- [ ] No names, contacts or images of people without documented consent; no other participants' projects
- [ ] Third-party assets have a recorded origin and licence
- [ ] Every claim has a status (Working / Prototype / Offline-tested / Designed / Planned) and evidence
- [ ] `python3 scripts/disclosure_check.py` and `--commits origin/main..HEAD` pass
- [ ] Commit messages and this PR text contain nothing from the lists above
